MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 30
   C. 22
   D. 44

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 29
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

5. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

6. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. 2/2
   D. Cannot tell

8. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.025

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

10. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 2

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

12. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40.5
   C. 9
   D. 81

13. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 24

14. Solve for x: x + 3 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 3
   C. 12
   D. 14

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 13

17. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

18. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 8

19. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

20. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 19
   C. 38
   D. 60

22. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

23. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
